Synopsis:
After meeting Karlach and choosing whether to keep her alive or kill her, Mizora appears in camp to turn Wyll into a devil or reward him with a new power.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_MizorasJudgement_CFM.json: The party has already encountered Karlach and the player made a consequential choice about whether she lived or died — Karlach may therefore be present in camp, absent, or hostile depending on earlier flags. Off‑screen, Wyll has an existing link to Mizora (a fiendish figure) or has been in communication with her, and Mizora now manifests through a diabolical summoning circle to offer Wyll either infernal transformation or a new power. The player (and any nearby companions) arrive as the ritual completes; Wyll is startled and Mizora spreads her wings as the portal closes. Tension is high because prior Karlach–Wyll confrontations and the player’s earlier decisions can influence how companions react.

context: The party has already met Karlach and the player’s earlier choice about her (alive, dead, or hostile) can affect who’s in camp and how companions react. Off‑screen, Wyll has an established fiendish link or has been communicating with Mizora, who now materializes through a diabolical summoning circle as the player and companions arrive — Wyll is startled and Mizora spreads her wings as the portal closes. Mizora is there to make a bargain: in different outcomes she offers Wyll infernal transformation (turning him into a devil) or a new infernal power — in some variations the pact also involves saving or dooming his father. Tension is high because prior Karlach–Wyll confrontations and the player’s choices shape the scene and companion responses.
